_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Item Unique Identification (IUID) Marking Activity, Validation and Verification Report
summary: The IUID Marking Activity, Validation and Verification Report is a tabular list providing IUID marking activity, validation and verification data such as physical asset marking, registration, and audit results.
use_relationship:
The Item Unique Identification (IUID) Marking Activity, Validation and Verification Report is a tabular list providing IUID marking activity, validation and verification data such as: physical asset marking, registration, inventory audits, quality audits, and verification/validation results.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID may be applied in any contract which contains a requirement for marking parts and equipment with IUID encoded in data matrix symbols.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document: MIL-STD-130.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of MIL-STD-130 shall be the latest version cited online at Acquisition Streamlining and Standardization Information System (ASSIST) Update, at the time of the solicitation. Other documents referenced in MIL-STD-130 shall also be applied.

preparation_instructions.title: A representative sample of IUID-related data matrix marks on items in each delivered Contract Line Item Number/Sub-Contract Line Item Number/Exhibit Line Item Number (CLIN/SLIN/ELIN) shall be validated and verified. Verification and validation results shall be provided using this report format. Marks failing verification or validation must be replaced with compliant marks prior to government acceptance of the items.
The tabular report shall include the following alphanumeric fields:

children.title: For items marked that 'Fail' IUID validation or verification, identify corrective action (whether the item has been re-marked or scrapped).
children.content: Other Event/Activity will be defined in the Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLS) if required.

preparation_instructions.title: The Key attributes for the report are the validation and verification columns which each indicate (Pass/Fail).
preparation_instructions.content: (NOTE: Most verification apparatus provide electronic records with pass/fail summaries for both verification and validation.) A 'Pass' validation value shall be assigned to records whose data matrix symbol(s) properly encode Item Unique Identification data as prescribed in MIL-STD-130 DoD Standard Practice Identification Marking of U.S. Military Property requirements for machine readable information (MRI) marking. A 'Pass' verification value shall be assigned to records whose data matrix symbol(s) meet or exceed MIL-STD-130 DoD Standard Practice Identification Marking of U.S. Military Property requirements for data matrix symbol quality.

preparation_instructions.title: The Contractor shall ensure machine-readable IUID marks required under this contract are permanently placed on the items subjected to contractually-required performance testing prior to that testing;
preparation_instructions.content: and further shall include all mark serviceability problems in the item's test report(s).
